title: Multimodal 101: Beyond Text
summary: How models handle images, audio and video, where they fail differently from text models, and how to choose and use them.
outcome: Build and ship a multimodal app that handles real inputs, with measured latency and cost and clearly stated limitations.

project.title: Ship a Multimodal Build
deliverables: A working app combining at least two modalities on real, messy inputs from your domain
Handle modality-specific failures: unreadable regions, silence, hallucinated chart values, ambiguous references
Latency and cost per request, broken down by modality
A written account of one real failure: what broke, how it was detected, what changed
Package with a README so someone else can run it with their own inputs and credentials

modules.title: Beyond text: what a multimodal model is

topics.d: Non-text inputs become tokens for the same transformer.
Mixed-data training vs chaining OCR/ASR/captioning before a text LLM.
Reasoning and output are almost always text.

topics.t: What carries over from text LLMs
topics.d: Context windows, tokens, sampling and failure modes still apply.
Many inputs, mostly text output.
Tone in speech, layout in scans.

modules.tryIt: Send the same chart as an image to a native multimodal model and as OCR-extracted text to a text-only model, then compare answers.
modules.outcome: Tell whether a product uses a native multimodal model or a pipeline.
modules.mentalModel: Image / audio / video → tokens → shared transformer → text out

modules.title: Vision: how images become tokens

topics.d: Images are split into patches and embedded.

topics.t: Why one image costs many tokens
topics.d: Cost scales with resolution, not file size.
High-detail modes tile large images, each tile billed.
Small text, thin lines, dense tables and chart labels.
Screenshots crowd out instructions and history.
Trading detail against token cost.

modules.tryIt: Send one screenshot at full resolution, half resolution and cropped to the relevant region, then compare tokens, cost and answer quality.
modules.outcome: Estimate an image's token cost and pick a resolution and crop strategy.

modules.title: Vision: capabilities & failure modes

topics.d: Reading text, describing scenes, extracting fields, coarse chart reading.
Recurring weak spots.
Confident values that the image never contained.
Plausible descriptions from patches, not measurement.
Your documents, resolution and formats.
Higher resolution, crops, structured output, verification or review.

modules.tryIt: Build ten test images (crowded shelf, dense table, low-res receipt, handwritten note) and score how often the model is exactly right.
modules.outcome: Predict which visual tasks need cropping, resolution or verification.

modules.title: Vision: documents, charts & visual RAG

topics.d: Digital PDFs carry text; scans must be recovered from pixels.
Accuracy, cost, latency and layout preservation.
Columns, headers, footnotes and sidebars scramble badly flattened text.
Merged cells, multi-page tables, checkboxes and key-value pairs.
Values are estimates from axes and labels.
Field names, types and required fields first.
Check types, ranges, dates, totals and required values.
Return where each value came from.
Invented values, merged rows, unit confusion and misread handwriting.
Human review instead of silent writes.
Embedding page images or regions.
Search text and page images together.

topics.t: Citing the page you answered from
topics.d: Page or region citations.
Clean digital text rarely needs page images.

topics.t: The token cost of page images
topics.d: Page images cost far more tokens than text.

modules.tryIt: Run one scanned invoice and one clean digital PDF through a text pipeline and a vision pipeline, comparing accuracy, cost and latency.
modules.outcome: Read real PDFs and scans, extract validated fields and answer with page citations.
modules.mentalModel: Document → pages → text layer + page images → layout & regions → structured fields or retrievable units

modules.title: Vision: image & video generation

topics.d: Diffusion models iteratively remove noise.
Subject, composition, style and detail, loosely.
Same prompt + seed reproduces an image.
Effects on quality, time and cost.
Pick the mode the task needs.
Reference images plus pose, depth or edge guidance.
Most candidates are discarded.
Cross-frame consistency makes cost and failures grow.
Watermarking, content credentials and licensing.

modules.tryIt: Generate one prompt at three seeds and three aspect ratios, then inpaint the best result instead of re-prompting.
modules.outcome: Control generated images iteratively and judge review time and rights risk.
modules.mentalModel: Noise → repeated denoising guided by the prompt → image

modules.title: Audio: how sound becomes tokens

topics.d: Sampled audio becomes spectrograms or learned audio tokens.

topics.t: Cost per second, not per word
topics.d: Silence and noise are billed too.
STT into an LLM vs models that hear directly.
Tone, emphasis, hesitation, overlap and emotion.
Conversations are judged on response delay.
Accents, code-switching, jargon, bad mics and silence.

modules.tryIt: Run the same 30-second clip through a speech-to-text model and an audio-native model, then ask both about the speaker's mood.
modules.outcome: Choose between transcription pipelines and audio-native models.

modules.title: Audio: speech to text & text to speech

topics.d: Transcript, optional word timestamps and confidence signals.
Complete recordings vs partial text while speaking.
Degradation sources; vocabulary hints help.
Who spoke when, as a separate step.
Which errors matter downstream.
Audio in a chosen voice, whole or streamed.
Pace, pauses and emphasis.
Names, acronyms, numbers and code-mixed text.
Play the first audio while the rest is generated.
Cost, latency, privacy and voice quality.

modules.tryIt: Transcribe a five-minute Hindi-English recording, read it back with a synthetic voice, and note where each step breaks.
modules.outcome: Build a speech pipeline with visibility into lost accuracy and latency.
modules.mentalModel: Audio → transcript + timestamps + speakers → text → synthesized audio

modules.title: Audio: realtime voice agents

topics.d: Silence beyond about a second breaks conversation.
Capture, network, STT, thinking, TTS and playback.
STT→LLM→TTS vs realtime audio-in/audio-out APIs.
Latency, control, cost and debuggability.
Start synthesis early; transcribe while the user speaks.
Deciding when the user has stopped.
Thinking pauses and background chatter.
Stop playback when the user interrupts.
Faster, but risks acting on unfinished speech.
Don't believe the user heard what they did not.
Holding phrases, reconnection and graceful exits.
Where to put safeguards.
Keep talking while slow lookups run.
And what to do when a tool fails.
Capture audio, transcript, timings and turns.

modules.tryIt: Build a small STT → LLM → TTS loop and measure the delay from the end of your sentence to the first sound of the reply.
modules.outcome: Ship a voice agent that handles turn-taking and interruptions with short silences.
modules.mentalModel: User speech → VAD & endpointing → transcript → model → speech, with barge-in resetting the loop
